title: GG-Nav: Goal-oriented Grounding Chain-of-Thought Elicits Reasoning in Navigation Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emerging strong Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced navigation foundation models. However, these models still have unsatisfactory performance on goal-oriented navigation settings. In this paper, we first conduct a motivating study revealing that the key issue lies in the insufficient utilization of streaming observations and imprecise target localization. To tackle these challenges, we propose GG-Nav, a simple yet effective navigation framework that learns a structured chain-of-thought (CoT) mechanism via supervised fine-tuning to explicitly localize goal-relevant instances, accumulate grounding evidence, and support more reliable decision-making. translated_title: GG-Nav：面向目标的接地思维链激发导航基础模型中的推理能力
translated_abstract: 新兴的强大视觉语言模型（VLM）推动了导航基础模型的发展。然而，这些模型在面向目标的导航场景中的表现仍不尽如人意。本文首先进行了一项动机研究，揭示出关键问题在于对流式观测的利用不足以及目标定位不精确。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了GG-Nav，这是一种简单而有效的导航框架，它通过监督微调学习一种结构化的思维链机制，从而显式地定位与目标相关的实例、积累接地证据，并支持更可靠的决策。具体而言，该结构化思维链包含两个关键阶段：（i）“观测到证据”，该阶段对相邻决策步骤之间的所有中间帧进行推理，以保留有用的目标相关证据；（ii）“证据到决策”，该阶段将当前观测与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GG-Nav导航框架，通过监督微调学习结构化思维链机制（“观测到证据”与“证据到决策”两个阶段），显式定位目标实例并逐步积累接地证据，从而提升导航基础模型在面向目标导航任务中的表现。
en_tdlr: GG-Nav learns a structured chain-of-thought mechanism via supervised fine-tuning, with Observation-to-Evidence and Evidence-to-Decision stages that explicitly localize goal-relevant instances and accumulate grounding evidence to improve goal-oriented navigation performance.
